Filter data frame based on report_nr

Source: R/report.R
filter_report.Rd

Filter data frame based on report_nr

Usage

filter_report(df, report_nr)

Arguments

df

Data frame

report_nr

Required integer indicating the report_nr

Value

Filtered data frame with data for the report nr

Examples

filter_report(df_example, report_nr = 12)
#> # A tibble: 1,656 × 24
